title: Salaami har taraf shore buka hai
body:
Salaami har taraf shore buka hai
vidaae hazrate mushkilkusha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tazazzul masjide koofa me hai aaj
sutoone kaaba e eemaa'n gira hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ali ibne abitaalib mera sher
abhi talwaar se zaqmi hua hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ne juz ali qaatil ko apne
dame iftaar bhi sharbat diya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ali aisa saqi tha waa dareghaa
gala shabbir ka pyaasa kata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
pakad kar ibne muljim ko jo laaye
kaha as'haab ne ab hukm kya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bashafaqat poocha qaatil se Ali ne
qata meri hai ya teri qata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kiya bin baap ka bacho'n ko mere
yahi ehsaan ka mere sila hai
